en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on magic tricks

Y-You're into that shit!? What, you wanna
understand Gonta better or somethin'...?

O-Or is this your way of sayin' that you're
not that into me!?

What!? But you got a gorgeous inventor
with huge titties standin' right here!

You'd rather look at a screen like a weirdo
than be with a real-life woman!?

Do you get off on that sorta thing like
an old dirty bastard or somethin'?

Wh-What do you mean, tricks!?
Th-That doesn't interest me at all!

Th-They're just gonna explain how
they pull off the trick, right?

W-Well, it sounds like a decent enough
time-waster so I guess I'll stick around.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
